title: Chapter 16 — Universal Procedural Organization and Final Synthesis
objective: Unify the full procedural framework into a single cross-scale organizational synthesis while preserving strict projection-layer boundaries, derivational continuity, and non-metaphysical scope discipline.
formal_sources_used: D:/projects/acellorator/docs/MPF_Core_Formalism_v1.md (SSOT primitives, ordering, stabilization thresholds, collapse modes, projection calculus framing)

derivation_chain_assertions: Transport corridors derived as residue-reinforced accessibility structures (R_t -> C_corridor).
Recursive identity persistence derived as route-level admissibility coherence preserving residue-coherent re-entry (A_route -> Identity_recursive).
Cooperative persistence derived as mutual admissibility relations preserving mutual residue-coherent re-entry (A_mutual -> Persistence_cooperative).
Civilization-scale stability derived as networked mutual admissibility coherence across many locally distributed interactions (sum A_mutual -> Stability_civilization).
cross_scale_validation.non_reductionist_boundary: Cross-scale continuity does not claim strict reduction; projection-layer compression changes language without asserting new primitives.

method_notes: Projection-layer terms summarize stabilized patterns at different resolutions.
Coarse-graining is non-injective; macro descriptions are not uniquely invertible to micro sequences.

Specify campaign-level falsification vectors for each layer (corridor, identity, cooperation, network stability) consistent with governance requirements.
future_campaign_targets: Corridor formation/stability sweeps under controlled residue/admissibility perturbations (R_t -> C_corridor).
